# Music and stingers

## OpenGameArt cc0-music

- Source: https://opengameart.org (one page per track, listed in `apps/web/public/assets/audio/opengameart/cc0-music/CREDITS.md`), downloaded 2026-10-30.
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. No attribution is required; we credit anyway. The licence text is saved as `LICENSE.txt` next to the files.
- Tracks (title, author): Slow Stride (isaiah658), relax_background1 (joaquinton), jazz improvisation looped (Pro Sensory), Determined Pursuit (Emma_MA), Win Jingle (Fupi), Game over short jingle (Kosmo The Cat). Re-encoded to MP3 and trimmed; total about 4.4 MB.
- Used by: `apps/web/src/lib/music.ts` (four background loops and the win and loss stingers).
